name: The Tome of Valor
summary: In Stormwind, The Tome of Valor calls paladins to prove their faith and courage. Duthorian Rall awaits those ready to petition the Church.

sections.title: Tempering the Spirit
sections.body: The Tome teaches that valor is forged through hardship. Its sacred text likens virtues to precious ores, valuable when found but refined to endure. Through hard trials and true commitment, a paladin binds faith, compassion, and courage into strength against the evils threatening Azeroth.

sections.title: Petitioning the Church
sections.body: After reading the Tome, you are directed to Duthorian Rall, a respected paladin leader in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He hears petitions from those seeking the trials of valor. The tests are no mere ritual. Defending the innocent and upholding the Church may cost your life, and only the steadfast earn recognition in the order.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what is the tome of valor quest
why do i need this quest
faq.answer: The Tome of Valor guides an initiate from holy doctrine toward perilous trials. After reading it, aspiring paladins petition Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light for tests of faith and courage.
Duthorian Rall is a high-ranking paladin and teacher in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He oversees the training of promising defenders and the trials that prove an initiate's worth to the Church.

faq.q: Why does the Church test its paladins so severely?
faq.answer: The Church of the Holy Light tests paladins so they can stand firm against despair and violence. Weak resolve or fragile faith could cost lives in battle, so instructors test and temper each initiate before critical holy missions.

faq.q: Where does this trial take place?
aliases: where to turn in tome of valor
faq.answer: You bring your petition to Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light, at the heart of Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

angles.text: As a paladin, this trial marks a defining step in your growth. It binds your martial skill to disciplined faith and selfless service.
As a member of the Alliance, you share in the strength these Stormwind trials preserve, in defense and in spirit during turbulent times.
